title: 개인정보 동의서 읽기: 무엇을, 왜, 언제까지?
objective: By the end, you can read a Korean personal information consent form and find the collected items, the purpose, and the keeping period. You can also tell required (필수) boxes from optional (선택) ones and check the right box.
summary: Learners read a Korean personal information consent form and find what is collected, why, for how long, and which boxes are required.
note: This form is a sample made for study, and the school name is not real.

task.title: Read and find information
task.line: Read each short form line or situation, then answer in English or write the Korean word.

sections.heading: The form
paragraphs: 1. 수집 항목: 이름, 생년월일, 휴대폰 번호, 이메일
2. 이용 목적: 수업 등록, 수업 안내 문자 보내기
※ 동의하지 않아도 됩니다. 하지만 [필수] 항목에 동의하지 않으면 수업에 등록할 수 없습니다.
[필수] 개인정보 수집·이용에 동의합니까?  □ 동의함  □ 동의하지 않음
[선택] 할인·이벤트 소식을 문자로 받겠습니까?  □ 동의함  □ 동의하지 않음

items.text: Information about you, such as your name and phone number.
items.example: 개인정보는 다른 사람에게 주면 안 돼요.

items.text: The list of information they will take from you.
The reason they need your information.
items.example: 서명하기 전에 이용 목적을 꼭 읽어 보세요.

items.text: How long they keep your information.
Write the year, month, and day you were born.
You must agree to this to use the service.
items.example: 필수 항목에 동의해야 가입할 수 있어요.

items.text: You can say no and still use the service.
Check this box to say yes.
Check this box to say no.
Sign your name by hand at the bottom of the form.

sections.heading: Reading tips
paragraphs: Look for three things first: 수집 항목 (what they take), 이용 목적 (why), and 보유 기간 (how long they keep it).
You must check '동의함' for a [필수] box to sign up. A [선택] box is up to you. Ad and event text messages usually come from [선택] boxes.

exercises: Read the line from a gym form. How long does the gym keep your information? Answer in English: 보유 기간: 회원을 그만둔 날부터 6개월
Read the line from a hair salon form. Which one is NOT collected? Choose one: 수집 항목: 이름, 생년월일, 주소 — (a) 이름 (b) 휴대폰 번호 (c) 주소
Read the line from a restaurant form. Why do they need your phone number? Answer in English: 이용 목적: 예약 확인 문자 보내기
Write 필수 or 선택 for each situation: ① 이 항목에 동의하지 않으면 회원이 될 수 없어요. ② 이 항목은 안 골라도 회원이 될 수 있어요.
Fill in the blank with one word: 할인 쿠폰 문자를 받고 싶지 않아요. 그래서 '____하지 않음'에 체크했어요.
Put the steps in order: 서명하기 / 수집 항목 읽기 / '동의함'에 체크하기
answers: 6 months from the day you quit the membership
To send you a text that confirms your reservation
